column7: 2026-11-04: Payroll build will later get a quarter token (separate change, not yet added). Quarters are Australian financial-year quarters: year starts 1 July, so Jul-Sep is Q1, Oct-Dec Q2, Jan-Mar Q3, Apr-Jun Q4. User will do it as its own change.

2026-11-04: Grants build will later get a quarter token (not added yet, user deferred it). Grants use the US federal fiscal year, starting 1 Oct: Oct-Dec is Q1, Jan-Mar Q2, Apr-Jun Q3, Jul-Sep Q4. This differs from the payroll branch, which uses Australian FY quarters (starts 1 Jul), so don't copy that mapping.
2026-11-04: Weekday token {ddd} (short English names, local timezone via getDay) added on grants branch alongside uncommitted {MMM}; nothing committed yet.
2026-11-04: {Q} quarter token added (src/index.js, tests, readme, index.d.ts) using Australian FY quarters (Jul-Sep = Q1), per earlier decision. Uncommitted, alongside the {MMM}/{ddd} changes.
